name: Understanding Design and Environment
description: This course explores the interplay between design and the environment, examining how human-centered design decisions impact ecological systems. Students will critically analyze environmental consequences of products, services, and systems, and learn to apply sustainable and regenerative design principles through real-world problem contexts.
